context.label: Communities, suffering, and final charge

observations.body: An overseer’s household and reputation are examined. This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work. Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.
observations.label: An overseer’s household and reputation are examined

payload.posture: Read 1 Timothy 3:1–7 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states an overseer’s household and reputation are examined. This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work. Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
